text.p: Polycom Inc on Wednesday said that it has entered into an agreement with Minnesota Mining and Manufacturing Co to jointly develop meeting and presentation products.
Under the agreement, 3M will provide Polycom with $3 million in research and development funding and shared technology resources for the development of future products.

Polycom said that 3M will receive a warrant for two million Polycom shares at $7.50 per share over two to three years. 3M will also receive exclusive private label rights in selected distribution channels under a royalty agreement for those Polycom-developed products.
Polycom develops, manufactures and markets audioconferencing and dataconferencing products that facilitate meetings at a distance.
